comparisons.peer_topic: Credit Card and Automobile Loan Securitization Activities and Structure
comparisons.peer_summary: The Corporation securitizes originated and purchased credit card and automobile loans as a financing source, selling them on a non-recourse basis to consolidated trusts with ongoing funding via repayments or new issuances. The Corporation maintains continuing involvement through servicing and holding various subordinated interests, including an undivided seller's interest and other retained interests.
comparisons.comparison: Both Citigroup and Bank of America securitize credit card receivables through trusts that are consolidated on their respective balance sheets. Citigroup specifically identifies 'Master Trust and Omni Trust' as the vehicles, stating liabilities are included on the Consolidated Balance Sheet. Bank of America describes a broader program including credit card and automobile loans sold on a non-recourse basis to consolidated trusts, also noting that the Corporation maintains continuing involvement through servicing and holding subordinated interests, mirroring Citigroup's retention structure.

sentences.text: As noted above, Citigroup securitizes credit card receivables through two securitization trusts-Master Trust and Omni Trust.
The liabilities of the trusts are included on the Consolidated Balance Sheet, excluding those retained by Citigroup.
The Corporation securitizes originated and purchased credit card and automobile loans as a source of financing.
The loans are sold on a non-recourse basis to consolidated trusts.

The Corporation's continuing involvement with the securitization trusts includes servicing the receivables and holding various subordinated interests, including an undivided seller's interest in the credit card receivables and owning certain retained interests.

comparisons.peer_topic: Credit Card Securitization Structure and VIE Consolidation
comparisons.peer_summary: JPMorgan Chase may securitize credit card loans through trusts like the Chase Issuance Trust, consolidating these assets as primary beneficiaries due to servicing responsibilities and other duties that involve directing VIE activities and absorbing potential losses.
comparisons.comparison: JPMorgan Chase and Citigroup both securitize credit card loans through trusts that they consolidate as primary beneficiaries or where liabilities are included on the balance sheet. JPMorgan specifies the 'Chase Issuance Trust' and notes it consolidates these trusts as a primary beneficiary due to servicing responsibilities and absorbing losses. Citigroup similarly consolidates liabilities of its 'Master Trust and Omni Trust', explicitly excluding only those retained by the company. Both disclose continuing involvement through servicing and retaining interests.

sentences.text: As noted above, Citigroup securitizes credit card receivables through two securitization trusts-Master Trust and Omni Trust.
The liabilities of the trusts are included on the Consolidated Balance Sheet, excluding those retained by Citigroup.
CCB's Card Services business may securitize originated credit card loans, primarily through the Chase Issuance Trust (the "Trust").

The Firm's continuing involvement in credit card securitizations includes servicing the receivables, retaining an undivided seller's interest in the receivables, retaining certain senior and subordinated securities and maintaining escrow accounts.

The Firm consolidates the assets and liabilities of its sponsored credit card trusts as it is considered to be the primary beneficiary of these securitization trusts based on the Firm's ability to direct the activities of these VIEs through its servicing responsibilities and other duties, including making decisions as to the receivables that are transferred into those trusts and as to any related modifications and workouts.

comparisons.peer_topic: Firm's alternative role and consolidation criteria in MTOB trusts
comparisons.peer_summary: The Firm may extend a temporary loan to the trust instead of purchasing securities for remarketing and consolidates any trust in which it holds the residual interest.
comparisons.comparison: Both disclosures involve trusts and balance sheet consolidation, but the underlying assets and purpose differ. Citigroup consolidates trusts holding securitized credit card receivables. Morgan Stanley consolidates municipal tender option bond (MTOB) trusts in which it holds the residual interest. While both reflect consolidation criteria for special purpose vehicles, the specific business driver (credit card loan financing vs. MTOB liquidity) and asset type are distinct.
